findings.title: Race between webhook retry and manual sync writes duplicate fulfillment
findings.body: Two concurrent writers can both pass the guard and insert a fulfillment row.
findings.fix: Take a row lock on the order before the check-then-insert.

findings.title: Discount stacking ignores currency rounding
findings.body: Two agents independently flagged the same rounding gap on stacked discounts.
findings.fix: Round once at the end, not after each discount.

findings.title: Log helper name does not follow the naming matrix
findings.body: getLogger performs no I/O, per teifi-conventions section 1 it should not be prefixed get.

findings.title: Unused import left over from a refactor
findings.body: Import of `crypto` is unused after the signature check moved.

findings.title: Refund total may double-count a tip
findings.body: Speculative -- verifier could not reproduce a path where the tip line is summed twice.

findings.title: [TS-1] Unsafe cast on inventory adjustment payload
findings.body: const qty = payload as any; -- a bare `as any` cast on external webhook input, no runtime type check follows it.
findings.fix: Parse payload with the zod schema and drop the cast.

findings.title: [TS-1] Type safety concern in inventory handler
findings.body: This function handles any inventory update and could fail for any malformed input; consider adding validation.

findings.title: [SEC-7] Session token is logged
findings.fix: Remove the token from the log payload.

findings.title: [SEC-7] Possible session concern
findings.body: The session handling might expose sensitive data in some circumstances.

findings.title: Operator-flip mutation escapes the happy-path assertion
findings.body: Changing the retry guard from && to || still passes the only assertion.
findings.fix: Add a case that exercises one false operand.

findings.title: Mock assertion freezes the client call shape
findings.body: The test asserts toHaveBeenCalledWith instead of the observable result.

pre_existing.title: Repo-wide: no retry backoff on the fulfillment API client
pre_existing.body: Pre-existing since before this diff; noted for awareness only.

open_questions: Is the webhook retry expected to be idempotent, or does the client dedupe upstream?
